# WhiteMagic

> Local-first memory and session continuity for coding agents, over MCP. Rust, MIT, no telemetry, no cloud service. Records what matters, finds it after restart, and carries decisions into the next session — on your machine.

WhiteMagic gives an AI coding agent durable project memory: explicit MCP routes, lexical search without an external model, session record/replay, cross-session continuity, an install/host-health selftest, and Linux Landlock containment. Trusted, local, single-user operation. Truthful degradation when optional models are unavailable.

## Install

The checksum-verifying installer uses Gen 3 v11.2.1 on Linux x86-64/ARM64
with glibc 2.39 or newer and Apple Silicon macOS.

```sh
curl -fsSL 'https://www.whitemagic.dev/install.sh?ref=gen3-llms' | sh -s -- --version v11.2.1 --dir "$HOME/.local/bin"
"$HOME/.local/bin/wm" --version
"$HOME/.local/bin/wm" grimoire --plan
```

See the [install guide](https://www.whitemagic.dev/install) for manual checksums,
the Gen 2 Windows/Intel macOS fallback, and a first save-and-recall exercise.

## Connect an MCP client

Use the [recipe for your client](https://www.whitemagic.dev/install#clients).
For clients accepting `mcpServers` JSON, supply real absolute paths:

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "whitemagic": {
      "command": "/absolute/path/to/wm",
      "args": ["--store", "/absolute/path/to/whitemagic/gen3", "serve", "--profile", "cyberbrain"]
    }
  }
}
```

The server speaks stdio JSON-RPC. `cyberbrain` is the default compact profile;
`full` exposes the wider registered surface. Inspect `initialize` and
`tools/list` from the exact binary/profile for its names and schemas;
`wm contract --json` reports the route contract. Explicit routing is the
dependable contract.

## Hosted lanes (read-only beta)

A read-only hosted MCP endpoint for evaluation runs lives at
<https://mcp.whitemagic.dev/mcp> (streamable-http; keyless
`initialize`/`tools/list` for directory probes; self-serve evaluation keys via
<https://mcp.whitemagic.dev/keys> or `POST https://mcp.whitemagic.dev/api/keys/request`;
x402 session passes in USDC on Base/Arbitrum/Polygon). The hosted store is curated public content
only — your local memory store is never uploaded. A stateless
receipt-verification API runs at <https://api.whitemagic.dev> (`/health` and
`/info` keyless; `POST /verify` for continuity-receipt bundles).

## Verify

```bash
export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"
wm --version          # wm 11.2.1 (Gen3 line)
wm selftest --json    # install invariant + host_status/host_health
wm selftest --strict  # exit 1 only when the host verdict is critical
wm wave4-benchmark    # Wave-4 Takwin & trace-shrinking benchmark (PEB-23..25)
```
